g.text: Finite-Heavy RTL confirmation · 20 paired seeds · one boundary
N4, D16, W5M · Heavy p=0.8; each Sparse p=0.02; sink-ready p=0.9
Lines pair the same seed across quotas; diamonds and brackets show means and pointwise 95% CIs.
